verdict.rationale: Poke does offer a documented API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, the API docs page is described as having 'no interactive reference (static highlighted examples)' and no sandbox. The probes also found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, so there is no runnable, explorable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
